title: About Me

Background
I’m a student at BYU studying Statistics with an emphasis in Data Science and a minor in Computer Science. I love learning and trying new things.

title: About Me

Education
Bachelor of Statistics, Data Science emphasis, Brigham Young University, expected Dec 2027 Minor in Computer Science Relevant coursework: Computer Science 111 Statistics 230 and 240, Calculus 1 and 2, Elementary Linear Algebra

title: About Me
text:
Fun Facts

I love mountain biking, and I was captain of GRIT (Girls Riding Together) on the Lone Peak Mountain Bike Team for five years
I love to travel, and London this summer is my favorite trip so far
I used to be a canopy tour guide at a ropes course so I’m trained in safety and emergency response
